initialExam.title: NVS TGT (Navodaya) 2026
initialExam.description: TGT recruitment for residential Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas providing quality education to rural talented students.
initialExam.syllabus: Tier-1: Language (Hindi/English), Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge (100Q). Tier-2: Subject Knowledge (70Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Tier-1: 100 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours. Tier-2: 70 questions, 100 marks, 1.5 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Interview → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: TGT in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (residential schools)
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit navodaya.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: Free accommodation (residential), DA, HRA, Medical, Vacation
